subject: Post-demo: clarifying sticker price and procurement lanes
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@stellarretail.com>, Stellar Retail Procurement <procurement@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: post-demo notes + suggested spend bands

Hi Daniel — thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks to help us size the right procurement lane for Stellar Retail.

Key points from the demo:
- You expect ~15–30M tokens/month initially for product search resumés with 2–3x spikes during promotions.
- Latency SLO target: 200–300ms p95 for short completions.
- Data residency: US-only; private tenancy preferred for payment card use cases.

Budget/price calibration (proposed):
- Sticker $/1M tokens: $450 (baseline, hosted Redwood catalog model)
- Committed band pricing: 10–50M tokens/month -> target $350–400/1M with a 12-month commit and reserved capacity
- Procurement threshold note: PO $50k+ triggers vendor onboarding; smaller pilots can be handled via credit card or short-term invoice.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_sticker_v1.xlsx (breakdown by model and commit slab), proposed_po_thresholds.pdf (legal + procurement notes).

Asks/next steps:
1) Can you confirm the expected steady-state monthly band (best guess: low/mid/high)? That will determine whether we recommend hosted vs dedicated.
2) Would procurement need a formal SOW to start the onboarding, or can we proceed with a PO once price and band are confirmed?
3) If you can share a primary procurement contact, I’ll get Laura to loop them in for PO timing and standard terms.

Thanks — I’ll hold off on formal pricing until we hear which band you expect.

Best,
Markus
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0193

---
Attachment: redwood_pricing_sticker_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12 rows)
Attachment: proposed_po_thresholds.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@stellarretail.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stellar Retail Procurement <procurement@stellarretail.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: post-demo notes + suggested spend bands

Markus — appreciate the clear summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side:  

1) Token estimate: realistic steady-state looks like 20M tokens/month (search + small chat features) with short-term peaks up to ~45M during big promo weeks.
2) Procurement: our finance team requires a PO for any vendor spend over $30k/month, not $50k — that's an important threshold for us. Anything below can go through Procurement’s pilot route (contract addendum + 30-day invoices).
3) Pricing sensitivity: our VPs are comfortable with a $/1M token target closer to $300 if we commit to 12 months and include basic monitoring/instrumentation in the bundle.

Procurement contact: procurement@stellarretail.com (they’re on CC). They’ll need an itemized price sheet and a sample PO/term summary to kick off vendor onboarding.

If you can send revised slabs reflecting the $30k/month PO threshold and a $300 target with minimum commitment options, I’ll route to finance next week.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of Product Operations, Stellar Retail

---
Note: forwarded to procurement for intake.

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Stellar Retail Procurement <procurement@stellarretail.com>
Date: 2026-06-02T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: post-demo notes + suggested spend bands

Thanks Daniel — that’s super-helpful. Two quick confirmations: 

- We’ll re-run the slab math with a $30k/month PO threshold, and include an option at ~$300/1M with a 12-month commit for the 20–45M band. I’ll show the delta to the $450 sticker and an unlocked-hosted vs dedicated cost comparison so you can see the unit economics.
- I’ll also include monitoring and basic instrumentation (token-level cost dashboards + latency traces) in the committed bundle to match your VP ask.

Laura — can you please produce: (a) an updated pricing spreadsheet with the $30k PO threshold and 12-month commit line items, (b) a short PO + onboarding checklist we can send to procurement? If you can have drafts by tomorrow EOD, I’ll push to Daniel and procurement first thing Thursday.

Daniel — any restrictions on contract language we should be aware of for the PO (e.g., data handling addenda)?

Thanks all — looping Laura to own the artifacts.

Best,
Markus

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@stellarretail.com>
Date: 2026-06-03T11:46:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Follow-up: post-demo notes + suggested spend bands

Hi Daniel / Markus — attaching the updated artifacts for procurement intake.

Summary of changes:
- Pricing spreadsheet: shows three bands (0–10M, 10–30M, 30–60M) with committed rate options. The 20M steady-state example lands in the 10–30M band with $320/1M for a 12-month commit; a 30–60M slab at $300/1M is available with a 12-month SLA-backed commitment and reserved capacity.
- PO threshold note: revised to call out $30k/month as the onboarding trigger (this corresponds to ~93k tokens/day at the $320 rate).
- PO + onboarding checklist: required items for vendor setup (W-9, insurance cert, standard terms, contact for SOC2 evidence).

Attachments: redwood_pricing_sticker_v1.xlsx, proposed_po_thresholds.pdf (updated).

Next actions for Stellar Retail procurement:
1) Confirm whether the 12-month commit with reserved capacity is acceptable to finance.
2) If yes, send a draft PO referencing the attached price worksheet and the PO checklist. Once we receive PO, our onboarding team will kick off and share a timeline (typically 7–10 business days for vendor setup).

Happy to hop on a 15-min call to walk procurement through the checklist if useful.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Strategic Accounts Ops, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
